additional_info.subject: RE: ID0392500-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP / R7 170002203] Primary convertor group has error CRM:01811000492
additional_info.body:
Hello Milan,
I hope this email finds you well.
We have reviewed the recent logs and can confirm that the errors with QA09-10 were temporary. The chargers are now functioning normally. Similarly, QA13-14, which had experienced some issues, are also working fine now. There was a temporary issue, but it has since been resolved.
Based on our analysis, we suspect that there might have been a problem with the feedback system. We recommend checking the connections of the contactors to rule out any issues. If the problem persists, please let us know so we can further investigate.
Additionally, successful charging has been completed on this charger. We will continue to monitor its performance for the next 24 hours, and if no issues arise, we will proceed with closing the case.
For your reference, here are the locations of the QA09-QA10 and QA13-14.
If you need any further clarification or have any questions, please feel free to reach out.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita Khobare
